notes.title: Ultimate Rumble is the new Mutator in today's patch!
notes.content:
With today's patch we are bringing total mayhem to [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]. In order to do so we are adding a new mutator that let's you abuse the use of your special moves! Just join in any game with the [b]Ultimate Rumble[/b] mode on and just spam your ultimate but watch out as everyone else will also be spamming!

Are you ready to face this new challenge?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/9e46fd30c59a6f61901f0757edea53184159c1fb.png[/img]

Join our community on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/7rFW6Vz]Discord[/url] and don't forget to leave us a review here n Steam!

notes.title: Gus joins the Roster!
notes.content:
A new champion joins today the roster of [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]! [b]Gus[/b] is the second son of a humble family of Farmers. While working his fields, he tells everyone that he got abducted by an U.F.O. but nobody in town believes him, his face alone is enough to convince everyone that he is just plain mad. From the day he got kidnapped (it's true!) he started participating to the CARRUMBLE tournament, but nobody knows the real reason behind this choice.

[previewyoutube=iZ8SdEwYZYU;full][/previewyoutube]

--------------------------------------
[b]1.05 Patch Notes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Gus, a new Heavy Champion
[*] Fixed Dojo Map Lightning
[*] Fixed Golden Liveries layout
[*] Tuned Localization minor issues In French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Chinese (simplified)
[/list]

notes.title: CARRUMBLE new Arena: The Dojo Temple
notes.content:
This weeks update is a bit different its not about a new vehicle or game mode but rather a brand new Arena

The Dojo Temple is opening its doors as we speak.

Beware of the traps on the floor and pay attention to not be pushed in the ditch!

[previewyoutube=-1bMvhTUqpA;full][/previewyoutube]


This friday we will also reveal the roadmap for the upcoming months! Are you prepared? What would you like to see in the game? Let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/53d814d70f7659d0729209abd75433fc4d9c290c.png[/img]


Patch Notes 1.04:
- Fixed Player’s Diesel earned/used stats.
- Ronin special skins can now be seen in the Liveries menu.
- An invisible nasty tram has been spotted destroying the brawl at its very beginning - it’s been removed.
- Added a new arena: The Dojo Temple
- Fixed Online multiplayer Controller issue.

Have fun, CARRUMBLERS!

notes.title: Local Multiplayer Now Available for free!
notes.content:
We have heard your feedback from the beta and are really really happy to announce Local Multiplayer mode for [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]! Four players may now jump into the arena on the same PC and play shoulder to shoulder against each other! Bring your friends to the rumble and have fun! 

Join us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/qMnjDzy]DISCORD[/url] and don't forget to leave a review, let us know what you want to see next in [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/c3e3b61755e3e59e824cfeedcec97ad9a376b5cf.png[/img]

With this new update comes today a new set of patch notes, with some bug fixes and two new [b]golden skins[/b]. You can get the new liveries from the garage and those comes for free until the end of December!

[b]PATCH NOTES 1.0.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Added moveset list during first brawls
[*] Added Local Multiplayer
[*] Visual fixes
[*] New Sales
[/list]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/5f38b4bea139c51b53de687200178e80ae55879e.png[/img]

notes.title: Domino joins the roster!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pzCkINY4Lts;full][/previewyoutube]


A new champion joins today the roster of CARRUMBLE![b] Domino[/b] has been raised in a car depot in the middle of the desert. She doesn't do "girls stuff" and doesn't care what you think. She is a "Mechanic Heavy Metal Player Fighter" and she loves what she does. Her dream is to dominate the [b]CARRUMBLE[/b] League, but she doesn't need a reason to. [b]Try her right now![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/c02d10f15083f3854b5a0c8b0b27954f887f1ce7.png[/img]

This is just the first content that we are going to add in the next months to CARRUMBLE! Expect new vehicles, skins, arena and modes! Feel free to tell us what do you think and what do you want to see in the game!



Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Domino Joins the roster with Dust Devil and some brand new skins!
[*] Progression Bar during race rewards has been fixed
[*] UI Fix for a better support with 21:9 resolution
[*] Graphic fixes in MultiPark Arena
[*] You can't skip anymore the race rewards page, so everyone should have now enough time to check their stats at the end of a match
[*] Fixed Ultimate spawn in "Resource Free" mode on Halloween and Crossroad arenas
[*] Fixed SilverEye animation
[*] Added a new intro video
[*] Localisation fixes
[*] Daily bug fix
[*] New and better effects for the damaged vehicles textures
[*] New icon to properly show locked content until level 20
[*] Added new particles during explosions
[*] Arenas optimizations
[*] Mode, arena and mutator are now hidden in the lobby until last ten seconds before match
[*] Ui improvements inside the text drive mode
[*] Garage interface improvements
[/list]

notes.title: JOIN THE CARRUMBLE CLOSED BETA!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/9b016b08c7f15034d48294649e392d523aa96c46.png[/img]

[b]3DClouds[/b] is delighted to announce the start of the closed beta for the adrenalinic fighting game [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]. The [b]CARRUMBLE[/b] closed beta phase begins on Steam, Thursday 3rd October, and finishes 7th October. [url=https://gleam.io/rewards/MP7QF-carrumble-closed-beta-key?fbclid=IwAR2HjRPhWqR-khj3FlzAhPGHC647MqjYrFg-i3I6TRNYrkPAU6rAcBMTgEs]Register for the upcoming beta[/url], play and share your experience and feedback with the developers on [url=https://www.facebook.com/CARRUMBLEGame]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/qMnjDzy]Discord[/url].

Content available in this beta:
[list]
[*] 4 Champions to choose from: Old Rupert and his Betty, Tomo with the massive Ronin, Coral with the fast Blossom and Domino with the fearsome Dust Devil
[*] 3 different arenas to play on: Stadium, Multi-Storey Car Park, Crossroad
[*] Two different game modes to try
[*] Each Beta Player will have a special reward at launch!
[/list]
